thread:
Nina Park: Heads-up: benchmark demo webinar next Wed 11am PT. Need final runbook for registration page, Zoom config, recording copies, and post-event lead flows. Priority: clear privacy notice, timezone-aware reg, 1-day & 1-hour reminder emails, and two short social clips within 48h.
Ravi Singh: I'll draft reg page. Proposal: name, work email, track (product/platform), and opt-in checkbox for follow-ups. Keep it under 4 fields. A/B test CTA copy (Watch live vs Join demo).
Clara: Zoom settings to lock: cloud auto-record (audio+video), enable live transcription, record separate audio files, and enable post-meeting auto-generated transcript. Passcode ON. Require registration.
Evan J: Add alt-host (Clara) and local recorder on host machine as backup. Also pre-create an RTMP stream key in case we need a livestream fallback.
Nina Park: Good. Also add a small consent blurb on reg page: "Recordings & materials will be shared; personal data used for follow-up per privacy policy." Link to policy.
OpsBot: Note: set cloud retention to 7 days before auto-delete; copy to S3 archive on publish. Actioned.
Ravi Singh: Reg copy draft: "See Redwood Inference benchmarks in action: latency, cost, and optimization tips. 45 mins + live Q&A. Recording & 2 short clips delivered within 48h."
Clara: Greenroom plan: 30m pre-check: mic, screen-share demo, captions test, close apps, alt-host sign-in. On call: host Nina, alt Clara, producer Evan.
Evan J: Recording pipeline: Zoom cloud -> auto-export MP4 + VTT -> S3 raw -> automated trim job (0:30 social teaser, 0:30-1:30 highlight) -> QC -> share links to HubSpot asset library. I'll tag assets with event ID.
Nina Park: Lead routing rules: attendees who watch >= 10 min OR chat a question -> mark as engaged. Hot lead = engaged AND (job_title contains engineer OR infra OR product OR company in target list). Hot -> SDR ping within 24h. Non-attendee registrants -> nurture series.
HubSpotBot: Reminder: create custom property webinar_engagement (enum) and webinar_clip_sent (bool) for segmentation.
Ravi Singh: Can we add a 3-question survey in the replay email? NPS, most valuable segment, interest level in trial. Keep as modal link to limit friction.
Clara: Captions backup: native Zoom caption + Rev.ai live captions via webhook if accuracy < 90%. We'll run a quick 3-min caption test in greenroom.
Evan J: Timeline: publish reg page today; dry-run Tue same time; greenroom Wed 30m prior; publish recording & clips within 48h; replay email + survey at 48h. I'll create HubSpot workflow: registrant -> attendee flag -> engaged tag -> hot lead assignment.
Nina Park: Risk: missing recording. Contingency: if cloud file missing, fetch local backup from host within 4h; if both missing, escalate to infra to pull RTMP ingest logs and reconstruct. Redact any PII before asset sharing.
OpsBot: Action log: event_id=3264000001, archive_policy=cloud->s3->longterm, backup_contact=Evan J, sla_local_backup=4h.
Ravi Singh: Owners: copy=Ravi, reg page + A/B=Ravi, assets=Evan, Zoom ops=Clara, HubSpot workflows=Evan. I'll note in page metadata.
Clara: Quick note on permissions: allow recording downloads only to producer and ops for initial 72h; then wider access once redaction done.
Nina Park: Final ask: react :white_check_mark: if you own your item and post any blockers. I'll assemble the post-event checklist doc after confirmations.
Evan J: :white_check_mark: setting workflows now.
Clara: :white_check_mark: captions and alt-host set.
Ravi Singh: :white_check_mark: reg page published, A/B toggles in place.
Nina Park: Thanks team — see you in greenroom. :rocket:
